As chairman, he held a controlling stake in the company alongside his brother Robert D. Webb Jr. Its operations combined machinery sales and rental with parts, maintenance, engines and power systems for industrial customers.

long_biography.plain_text:
Endowed scholarships were one way Clark Boyce and his late wife, Laura, supported arts education at Louisiana State University. Their gifts assisted undergraduates studying interior design, painting and sculpture. His company also funded a graduate assistantship at the LSU Museum of Art, extending that support beyond undergraduate study.

The university named the Clark and Laura Boyce Gallery in recognition of their contributions. Renovated in 2021, it exhibits work by students, faculty and alumni and brings that work to a wider public. Their daughter Emalie continued the family’s involvement, helping direct donations towards scholarships and graduate assistantships that provided practical support to students.
